title: All day: Asia 20:00-00:00 - reclaim (long-view pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
notes: tools/allday.py, variant reclaim|asia|prev,0.5,6,cisd|S,None,eod; picked: long-view pick (2021-24, plateau score)

rules: Level: the window before's high / low.
Sweep: a 5m bar trades through the level by >= 0.5 x the 5m ATR(14).
Reclaim: within 6 bars a 5m close back inside that is also beyond the open of the candle run into the extreme (CISD).
Short after a high sweep, long after a low sweep; stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme; the setup's own level = the box's other side.
Target the setup's own level (see above; >= 1R away, banked at 8R).
Time exit: flat 15:55 ET. One trade a day. Entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop and time exits - 1 tick; $1.40 a micro.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
